def transform(grid):
    """Reflect rows across horizontal bands; mirror each row across the center column."""
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    if not g or not g[0]:
        return []
    # First band reads the source bottom-to-top, with each row mirrored then original.
    band = [row[::-1] + row for row in g[::-1]]
    return band + band[::-1] + band
